Subject: Quick intro + demo request

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the quick note after I signed up. Parsec Labs is evaluating embedding-based product search and reranking; the core ask is sub-100ms 95th percentile for search + real-time rerank at checkout. We have an existing vector store but are exploring a managed inference path to reduce ops burden.

A few specifics to help qualify: 
- Peak queries: ~3k QPS for our holiday peak (expected Nov–Jan), baseline steady-state ~350 QPS.
- Typical query length: short product titles + a few contextual attributes (avg 40 tokens).
- Timeline: PoC in next 6 weeks, production decision by end of Q1.
- Security: must support SSO + SOC2 controls; some data residency preferences in us-west.

I'm attaching a small traffic sample (parsec_sample_traffic.csv) to show hourly bursts.

Would love a 30-min demo focused on latency/throughput and what Redwood recommends for a pilot topology (Hosted vs Dedicated). Available next week mornings PST.

Thanks,
Alicia

Hi Alicia — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the traffic snapshot — that helps a lot. A couple quick qualification questions so we tailor the demo to your workload and can bring the right folks: 

1) Is the 3k QPS an absolute instantaneous burst, or distributed across many users/replicas? Any idea of concurrency per second vs sustained minute averages?
2) For rerank at checkout, are you hitting the same model as search or a lighter rerank model? Approx tokens/model size if known.
3) Do you expect persistent KV cache reuse across requests (i.e., same user/session getting many requests) or more cold prefixes?
4) Are there any compliance attachments you need ahead of time (SOC2 report, pen test summary) for procurement?

Quick calendars: Priyom (SDR) will help lock a slot and Ben (solutions) can join for throughput questions. We can propose 30-minute windows:

If those don't work, send 2–3 windows and Priyom will follow up with a proper calendar invite. We'll cover: workload profiling, recommended pilot infra (batching/quantization/caching), rough cost estimates, and checklist for a 6-week PoC.

Thanks — Vivek

Thanks Vivek — answers inline below and pasted some highlights from the attached sample.

On 2028-10-03 at 10:03, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai wrote:
> 1) Is the 3k QPS an absolute instantaneous burst, or distributed across many users/replicas?

Mostly distributed across many users but we've seen 20–30% of traffic concentrated in flash promotions — so short instantaneous spikes to ~3k for a few minutes are plausible. Typical sustained peak days are closer to ~1k–1.5k QPS.

> 2) For rerank at checkout, are you hitting the same model as search or a lighter rerank model?

We currently run a smaller distilled reranker (around 2–3B) for checkout and a larger 7B-ish model for search. Open to suggestions if Redwood recommends a unified approach for cost/latency.

> 3) Do you expect persistent KV cache reuse across requests (i.e., same user/session getting many requests) or more cold prefixes?

Mostly cold prefixes; sessions are short. We believe prefix reuse will be low.

> 4) Are there any compliance attachments you need ahead of time (SOC2 report, pen test summary) for procurement?

We may need SOC2 + encryption-at-rest certificate during procurement. For now the PoC can start without them but we'll request evidence later.

Preferred demo windows: Wed 2028-10-11 09:30 PT or Thu 2028-10-12 08:30 PT. Wed preferred.

Attaching a condensed traffic sample (parsec_sample_traffic.csv) with a couple of flagged spike windows.

Regards,
Alicia
